global_missing_evidence: Evidence of the exact pod termination and replacement timeline
Evidence of the service endpoints during the injection window
Evidence of the front-end deployment's readiness probe configuration
Evidence of the deployment's update strategy (e.g., maxSurge, maxUnavailable)

hypotheses.mechanism: The front-end deployment is configured with a single replica and no PodDisruptionBudget. When the pod is killed, there is no other ready pod to serve traffic, so the deployment's Ready count drops to 0. The replacement pod takes time to become Ready, causing a full outage window. The HTTP 200 responses during the injection window are likely due to the service still routing to the terminating pod or a load balancer caching, but the Ready count is the oracle and it drops to 0.

Evidence of any readiness probe configuration and its effect on pod readiness
